**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind lifecycle support to the current project**

When an accepted retained observation is reassigned from project A to project B without changing its evidence hash, A's existing `LifecycleEvent` still passes `lifecycle_event_supported` because this predicate checks only the hash/status and does not receive or validate the event project's identity. The reassignment path also does not rebuild A's lifecycle projection, so `/api/projects/{id}/state` can continue reporting A's old phase as supported by evidence whose current assessment names B; validate the assessment's project binding and rebuild the former project's projection during reassignment.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/89d4bb8c9f1c43c6f8b64cbdb1daab2012c360f9/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)

+def lifecycle_event_supported(
+    event_type: str, evidence: Evidence | None, interpretation: Interpretation | None
+) -> bool:
+    """Return whether an event retains valid evidence-bound accepted support."""
+    if evidence is None or interpretation is None or not interpretation.assessment:
+        return False
+    assessment = interpretation.assessment
+    if assessment.get("evidence_hash") != evidence.content_hash:
+        return False
+    accepted = interpretation.status == "accepted" or (
+        interpretation.status in {"failed", "pending"} and assessment.get("decision") == "accepted"
+    )
+    if event_type == "planning_application_withdrawn":
+        return accepted or assessment.get("withdrawal_supported") is True
+    return accepted

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate buying-chain citations against the selected project**

The repaired need-field projection now checks project/activity/admission, but this new parties projection labels every non-stale buying-chain candidate `SUPPORTED`. If retained evidence that created project A's contractor or buyer claim is later accepted and reassigned to project B with the same hash, `buying_chain_view` still treats the citation as current because `_accepted_version` checks only status/hash; A's latest run therefore keeps exposing the wrong buyer and no removal diff is produced. Apply the current assessment's project/admission predicate to retained buying-chain citations while retaining invalidated claims only in history.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/89d4bb8c9f1c43c6f8b64cbdb1daab2012c360f9/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)

+def _provenance(evidence: Evidence) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "id": str(evidence.id),
+        "url": evidence.url,
+        "extraction_location": evidence.extraction_location,
+        "source_date": evidence.event_date or evidence.published_at,
+        "retrieved_at": evidence.observed_at,
+        "support": "accepted interpretation",
+    }
+
+
+def _unknown() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"value": None, "status": "UNKNOWN"}
+
+
+def _supported(value: Any, evidence: list[Evidence]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return (

+        else _unknown()

+def _conflict(values: list[tuple[Any, Evidence]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
